lyrics:
[Intro]
Eda mone... enthaada ithu?
Kandu kandu maduthu da!
Phone-um pidichu irikkunno?
Life-il vision full undu, pakshe action zero!

[Verse]
"Naale thottu fresh start" ennu paranju,
Alarm vechu 5 o'clock-nu!
Alarm adichappol snooze cheythu mone,
Urakkam thudarnnu 10 o'clock-nu!
Book thurannal udane brain offline,
Reels thurannal mood full online!

[Chorus]
Overthinking CEO, action-il zero!
Insta-yil hero, real life-il zero!
Naale maarum, ellam maarum,
Ennu paranju varsham moonu kazhinju da!

[Verse 2]
Plan okke NASA level da,
Execution thara level da!
"4 PM-nu thudangam" ennu parayum,
4:02 aayal "Ini 5 PM-nu nokkam" ennu parayum!
Gym-il ponam, padikkanam, rich aakanam,
Pakshe bed-il ninnu erangan madi aanu mone!

[Bridge]
Mind-il multi-crore startup plan,
Hand-il scrolling-um 2% battery-um!
Lokathine muzhuvan pattikkam mone,
Pakshe glass-il nokki parayu... nee aaraa?

[Final Chorus]
Overthinking CEO, action-il zero!
Insta-yil hero, real life-il zero!
Naale maarum, ellam maarum,
Ennu paranju varsham moonu kazhinju da!
motivation: Okay mone 😂 roast okke kazhinju! Ini scene maattam. Right now: 1. Phone maatti vekku (silent aakku). 2. Cheyyaan ulla kariyaalettavum simple aaya ORE O RU task eduthu 20 minutes maathram focus cheythu cheyyu. Nee start cheythaal baaki auto flow aayikollum. Podaa chennu work thudangu!
